parameters.help_en:
The AI template ID. You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
When you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102930.html operation to add an AI template, the AI template ID is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response.
After the AI template is added, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102936.html operation to query the AI template ID, which is the value of the TemplateId parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh:
AI模板ID。可通过以下方式获取：
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102930.html接口添加AI模板时，AI模板ID为返回参数TemplateId的值。
AI模板添加后，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102936.html接口查询AI模板ID，为请求后返回参数TemplateId的值
parameters.name: template_id

TemplateInfo.description_en: The information about the AI template

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the AI template was created. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
CreationTime.description_zh: AI模板的创建时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

IsDefault.description_en:
Indicates whether the AI template is the default template. Valid values:
Default: The template is the default template.
NotDefault: The template is not the default template
IsDefault.description_zh:
是否为默认AI模板。取值：
Default：是。
NotDefault：否

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the AI template was last modified. The time is displayed in ISO 8601 format in UTC. The format is yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
ModifyTime.description_zh: AI模板修改时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

Source.description_en:
The source of the AI template. Valid values:
System: system.
Custom: custom
Source.description_zh:
AI模板来源。取值：
System：系统。
Custom：自定义

TemplateConfig.description_en: The detailed configuration of the AI template. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see [AITemplateConfig](~~89863#title-vd3-499-o36~~)
TemplateConfig.description_zh: AI模板详细配置，JSON字符串。具体配置，请参见[AITemplateConfig](~~89863#title-vd3-499-o36~~)

TemplateName.description_en: The name of the AI template

TemplateType.description_en:
The templatetype of the AI template. Valid values:

AIMediaAudit: automated review.
AIImage: smart thumbnail
TemplateType.description_zh:
AI模板类型。取值：

AIMediaAudit：智能审核。
AIImage：智能封面
